plugins.name: memory-kit
plugins.description: Claude Code agent that remembers where you stopped and whose "done" is checked: memory as plain dated files in your repository (nothing becomes a rule without your yes), guards for git, secrets and tests, and a method for delegating to helper agents — spec file, review of every diff, acceptance record, findings registry.
